info.name: Optimizely Campaign REST Assets Profiles API

items.docs: Creates a new customer profile or updates an existing one in ODP. Profiles are identified by one or more identifier fields such as email, customer_id, or vuid.

params.name: identifier_field
params.description: The identifier field name (e.g., email, customer_id, vuid)

params.name: identifier_value
params.description: The value of the identifier field

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of profile fields to return

items.docs: Retrieves a customer profile by a specific identifier field and value, such as email address or customer ID.
